scene_svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 1920 1080" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g id="background"><rect width="1920" height="1080" fill="#0A1628"/></g><g id="horizon_glow_outer"><line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1920" y2="540" stroke="#00D9FF" stroke-width="180" opacity="0.05"/><line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1920" y2="540" stroke="#00D9FF" stroke-width="110" opacity="0.07"/></g><g id="horizon_glow_mid"><line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1920" y2="540" stroke="#00D9FF" stroke-width="60" opacity="0.10"/><line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1920" y2="540" stroke="#00D9FF" stroke-width="32" opacity="0.16"/></g><g id="horizon_glow_inner"><line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1920" y2="540" stroke="#00D9FF" stroke-width="16" opacity="0.28"/><line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1920" y2="540" stroke="#00D9FF" stroke-width="8" opacity="0.45"/></g><g id="horizon_line_core"><line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1920" y2="540" stroke="#00D9FF" stroke-width="3" opacity="1"/></g><g id="horizon_line_highlight"><line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1920" y2="540" stroke="#F4F1EA" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.9"/></g><g id="endpoint_left"><circle cx="10" cy="540" r="4" fill="#F4F1EA" opacity="0.9"/><circle cx="10" cy="540" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#00D9FF" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/></g><g id="endpoint_right"><circle cx="1910" cy="540" r="4" fill="#F4F1EA" opacity="0.9"/><circle cx="1910" cy="540" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#00D9FF" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/></g><g id="wordmark"><text x="64" y="1016" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" letter-spacing="6" fill="#F4F1EA" opacity="0.7">NorthShield</text></g></svg>
notes: Le seuil de vigilance naît : une unique ligne d'horizon cyan traversant l'écran, au glow net construit en couches de traits empilés croissants en opacité, sur un fond volontairement vide. Le plus efficace à animer : le tracé de horizon_line_core de bord à bord via stroke-dasharray, suivi de l'apparition en cascade des couches de glow (outer vers highlight) puis du wordmark en fondu.
